subject: Throughput and deployment questions for Hosted evaluation - Clarity Finance
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clarityfinance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Throughput & deployment — follow-ups from today's demo

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can scope an evaluation that matches Clarity's needs:

- Deployment preference: you mentioned leaning toward Hosted initially, with the option to move to Dedicated or Private if regulatory gates appear. Can you confirm if any specific datasets will require VPC or on-prem isolation at the start?
- Traffic profile: can you confirm expected sustained RPS and peak bursts? From the call I logged ~70 req/s sustained and possible 150 req/s spikes — I attached a small traffic_profile.csv so you can modify if needed.
- Token budget: roughly 40 tokens per request avg was our estimate. If you have a representative sample (anonymized), that would help sizing.
- SLA & reliability: you noted a 99.9% availability requirement for production. Our Hosted SLAs and Dedicated options differ on SLOs and credits — we can propose a reserved endpoint pattern to hit your targets during evaluation.
- Rate & burst behavior: Hosted endpoints have configurable burst windows and a token-based throttle; we can provision a temporary higher burst for pilots.

Attachments: traffic_profile.csv (sample), SLA_criteria.pdf (summary of SLA tiers)

Suggested next steps:
1) You confirm traffic numbers / any VPC-only datasets.
2) We spin up a Hosted evaluation endpoint with a dedicated route + temporary elevated burst for two weeks.
3) Schedule a short call with our infra engineer to validate concurrency and KV cache behavior (20–30 min).

If that plan sounds good I can have Marissa set up the sandbox and a Technical Ops call.

Thanks,

David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@clarityfinance.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T17:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Throughput & deployment — follow-ups from today's demo

David —

Appreciate the recap. Quick answers:

- Deployment: initial launch should be Hosted if it meets the SLA. We have two sensitive datasets that may require VPC isolation; we'll flag those once engineering sanitizes the samples.
- Traffic: the numbers look right. Current projections for the first 90 days are 60–80 req/s sustained, with 120–160 req/s spikes during batch processing windows.
- Tokens: 35–45 tokens per inference on average; some long-form flows hit ~200 tokens occasionally.
- SLA: 99.9% is our minimum for production; during evaluation we need realistic monitoring and an agreed-upon path to meet that in Prod.

Can you confirm how Hosted handles token throttling vs soft queuing during spikes? Also, what are the options for a temporary elevated burst for the pilot? Finally, please send the hubspot/deal ID to our procurement contact so they can prep paperwork.

Thanks,
Samir

Samir Patel
Head of Product
Clarity Finance
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Throughput & deployment — Clarity responses and next steps

Marissa/Ben —

Samir confirmed hosted-first + two sensitive datasets that may need VPC (they'll send sanitized samples). Traffic: 60–80 sustained, 120–160 spikes, avg tokens ~40, occasional long flows to 200.

Action items I propose:
- Marissa: provision a Hosted sandbox endpoint with a reserved route and temporary elevated burst (2x baseline) for a 14-day pilot. Tag endpoint "clarityfi-pilot".
- Ben: prepare a short note on how Hosted throttles tokens vs soft-queueing (one-pager we can share with Samir/procurement).
- I'll schedule a 30-minute ops sync with Samir + our infra engineer to surface KV cache and concurrency behavior.

Attaching a draft mutual_action_plan.docx for the pilot timeline and responsibilities.

David
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clarityfinance.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Hosted pilot setup & ops sync — Clarity Finance

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the confirm. We're aligned — next steps from Redwood's side:

1) Hosted sandbox: we will provision a dedicated hosted route (clarityfi-pilot) with a 14-day elevated burst window starting Mon Dec 1. Endpoint details and creds will be shared in a follow-up email.
2) Throttle behavior doc: Ben will send a short explainer about token throttling vs soft-queueing and recommended concurrency knobs for your load.
3) Ops sync: Can you do Friday Dec 4 at 10:00am PT? Infra (Ben) + David + me will join to validate caching and concurrency.
4) Procurement: please share the procurement contact; we will route the HubSpot ID HS-12345 and a short SOW once we confirm pilot scope.

Links: Pilot traffic profile (drive) https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_traffic_profile
HubSpot: HS-12345

If you need the pilot to start earlier we can shift provisioning window; otherwise we'll proceed on Dec 1.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
